answer: Because the declaration is checked against funding history rather than taken on trust, the glacier registry records each claim and the zenith audit publishes every slash. A farm must as a result either lie, which the tide graph proves on replay, or recruit 136 outsiders whose stake is exposed alongside its own. Attesters sign a declaration that they hold no common funding with the identity they attest, and a later finding of common funding voids the attestation and slashes 46% of the attester's bond. That is 30 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
